description: This file contains implementation of Bluetooth GATT socket handling, including deserialization of attributes, processing of Bluetooth ATT protocol responses, security configuration, and socket state management within the Thunder Bluetooth namespace.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth attribute with deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT socket with security and state management functionalities.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Handles command deserialization for GATT socket communication.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream, handling variable length encoding and buffer management.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Command::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data streams for GATT socket commands, processing various ATT protocol responses.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Configures Bluetooth security levels on the socket, including security mode and encryption.

methods.name: GATTSocket::StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes, including retrieving connection info and triggering associated actions.
